item.description: The Flask hook implementation is minimal and does not properly intercept Flask route execution to provide meaningful group labels for HTTP requests. Currently, it only ensures Flask is available but doesn't hook into Flask's routing mechanism to extract route information.
item.contract: Modify the Flask hook to intercept Flask route execution and associate HTTP requests with the appropriate route definitions (both regular routes and error handlers) by capturing route decorators and method names to form meaningful group labels in the HTTP records.
